title: 2027 Graduate Analyst - AI, Data, and Platform Technologies - Dublin
description: **Company Overview** KKR is a leading global investment firm that offers alternative asset management as well as capital markets and insurance solutions. KKR aims to generate attractive investment returns by following a patient and disciplined investment approach, employing world-class people, and supporting growth in its portfolio companies and communities. KKR sponsors investment funds that invest in private equity, credit and real assets and has strategic partners that manage hedge funds. KKR’s insurance subsidiaries offer retirement, life and reinsurance products under the management of Global Atlantic Financial Group. References to KKR’s investments may include the activities of its sponsored funds and insurance subsidiaries. **THE PROGRAMME** This is a full-time in-person graduate position based in Dublin, Ireland, offered as an 18-month fixed-term contract commencing on September 6, 2027. You will join the Technology team as a Software Engineer for the duration of the programme and take part in a structured onboarding covering KKR and alternative investments. You will work on real production initiatives across the Investment Lifecycle and asset-class platforms, attend educational and network-building programming, and have the opportunity to showcase your work to technology leaders across the firm. **THE OPPORTUNITY** As part of our continued investment in Ireland, KKR is launching a Technology & Engineering Centre of Excellence in Dublin. This new hub will play a central role in building the world’s first technology platform engineered to manage over one trillion dollars in alternative AUM (assets under management). Designed from the ground up for scale, security and speed, this is the infrastructure for the future of global finance. Areas of focus include investment technology, portfolio construction and management, liquidity solutions, risk analytics, and advanced data platforms **THE TECHNOLOGY FUNCTION** KKR's Technology organisation is a global group of passionate technologists and product managers, unified by a shared mission to deliver exceptional products and solutions that drive value for our stakeholders, clients, and investors. Our passion for technology and innovation fuels our commitment to creating high-quality, impactful solutions that address complex challenges and meet the evolving needs of our sophisticated businesses. Teamwork is at the core of the organisation's success. We thrive on open collaboration and continuous learning, driving a culture that values diversity of thought and collective achievement. Our global footprint fosters the integration of a diverse set of ideas and viewpoints in product and solution delivery, allowing us to design more comprehensive solutions that are adaptable and scalable. We optimise for impact, prioritising and delivering solutions with excellence while remaining agile in response to the evolving needs of our businesses. **TEAM YOU WILL BE JOINING — AI, Data, and Platform Technologies (ADAPT)** ADAPT is the foundation of KKR Technology, bringing together its technology pillars — spanning AI and Applied AI, Data and Platform Engineering, Infrastructure, SRE, Technology Experience, and Program Management — to accelerate modernisation, automation, and insight. It delivers secure, scalable, business-aligned platforms and experiences that enable KKR to scale. **CRITICAL COMPETENCIES FOR SUCCESS** * Currently attending a university in Ireland, the UK, or continental Europe with an outstanding academic record, and available for a 6–9 month placement starting January 2027 * Currently enrolled in a bachelor's or master's degree in computer science or a related technical field (typically undertaking a placement/internship year or a work-integrated master's) * Eligible to work in Ireland on a full-time basis without the need for current or future visa sponsorship * Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint for data analysis and communicating ideas * Proficiency with Java, Python, C/C++ * Curiosity about and openness to adopting emerging AI technologies in day-to-day workflows * Ability to critically evaluate AI-generated outputs for accuracy and relevance * Familiarity with effective prompt design and generating reliable results using generative AI tools * Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills * Ability to act both strategically and tactically with exceptional attention to detail * Outstanding time management and organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks with competing deadlines * Team-player who enjoys working in a collaborative and collegial environment and is willing to pitch in when needed * Intellectual curiosity and an interest in financial services and alternative investments KKR is an equal opportunity employer. title: 2K Games - Engineering Graduate Program - Dublin
description: Founded in 2005, 2K Games is a global video game company, publishing titles developed by some of the most influential game development studios in the world. Our studios responsible for developing 2K’s portfolio of world-class games across multiple platforms, include Visual Concepts, Firaxis, Hangar 13, CatDaddy, Cloud Chamber, and HB Studios. Our portfolio of titles is expanding due to our global strategic plan, building, and acquiring exciting studios whose content continues to inspire all of us! 2K publishes titles in today’s most popular gaming genres, including sports, shooters, action, role-playing, strategy, casual, and family entertainment. Our team of engineers, marketers, artists, writers, data scientists, producers, problem solvers, and doers, are the professional publishing stewards of our growing library of critically acclaimed franchises such as NBA 2K, Battleborn, BioShock, Borderlands, PGA TOUR 2K, Mafia, Sid Meier’s Civilization, WWE 2K, and XCOM. At 2K, we pride ourselves on creating an inclusive work environment, which means encouraging our teams to Come as You Are and do your best work! We are dedicated to diversity and inclusion and want our community of candidates to reflect this commitment. We encourage all qualified applicants to explore our global positions. Kickstart your career with 2K’s Engineering Graduate Program. **Program Overview** The Engineering Graduate Program starts July 2027. Based out of our Dublin, Vancouver and US offices, launch your career in game development over a 21 month period. * Foundation Training (3 Months): Master game development fundamentals using industry-standard engines, engage in instructor-led projects, receive guided feedback & reviews, and develop essential soft skills for working in a studio environment. * Studio Rotations (18 Months): Complete 3 rotations across 2K studios (such as Hangar 13, Visual Concepts, Firaxis, HB Studios, Gearbox, and more), contributing directly to AAA titles. **What You Will Do** * Collaborate with multi-disciplinary engineering teams to build and support game features across our titles. * Write clean, efficient, and maintainable code, primarily in C++ & in the Unreal Engine. * Participate in instructor-led group projects, technical workshops, and guided reviews. * Troubleshoot, debug, and optimize systems across diverse engineering platforms and game engines. * Adapt quickly to varied studio workflows, version control tools (e.g., Perforce), and game release timelines. **Who You Are** * Graduated between January 2025 and July 2027 with a degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Physics, Mathematics, or a related technical field. * Proficiency in programming languages such as C++, C#, or Python. * Experience with the use of Unreal Engine, which will be evaluated during the assessment process. * Strong understanding of algorithms, data structures, and software design patterns. * Solid debugging, analytical, and problem-solving abilities with strong attention to detail. * Proactive, curious learner with a genuine passion for gaming and technology. **How To Apply** The next cohort of engineers will join us in July 2027. We will open recruitment starting on September 14th and encourage you to apply today and not wait before it is too late! Apply with a CV/resume and full information regarding academic history as requested on the application portal. Be sure to include any additional links (GitHub, itch.io, etc) to show us some of the cool things that you do! As an equal opportunity employer, we are committed to ensuring that qualified individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform their essential job functions, and receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us if you need a reasonable accommodation. Please note that 2K Games and its studios never use instant messaging apps or personal email accounts to contact prospective employees or conduct interviews and when emailing, recruiters only use 2K.com, take2games.com or zynga.com accounts.

title: 2K Games - Technical Art Graduate Program - Dublin
description: Founded in 2005, 2K Games is a global video game company, publishing titles developed by some of the most influential game development studios in the world. Our studios responsible for developing 2K’s portfolio of world-class games across multiple platforms, include Visual Concepts, Firaxis, Hangar 13, CatDaddy, Cloud Chamber, and HB Studios. Our portfolio of titles is expanding due to our global strategic plan, building, and acquiring exciting studios whose content continues to inspire all of us! 2K publishes titles in today’s most popular gaming genres, including sports, shooters, action, role-playing, strategy, casual, and family entertainment. Our team of engineers, marketers, artists, writers, data scientists, producers, problem solvers, and doers, are the professional publishing stewards of our growing library of critically acclaimed franchises such as NBA 2K, Battleborn, BioShock, Borderlands, PGA TOUR 2K, Mafia, Sid Meier’s Civilization, WWE 2K, and XCOM. At 2K, we pride ourselves on creating an inclusive work environment, which means encouraging our teams to Come as You Are and do your best work! We are dedicated to diversity and inclusion and want our community of candidates to reflect this commitment. We encourage all qualified applicants to explore our global positions. What is Technical Art? Technical Artists make the art team more capable than it would be on its own. The art team is your customer, its problems set your priorities, and your work is judged on whether the artists it was built for actually use it. In practice that means building the tools artists use to create content, the rigs that make characters move, the shaders that give a world its look, the rules that scatter a landscape with vegetation, and the pipelines that carry all of it into the game. Program overview 21 months, starting Summer 2027, based in Dublin. **Foundation Training. Eleven weeks.** You get a brief, a deadline, and the tools art teams use every day, and you work out how to deliver. You build across all four specializations, including the ones you are weakest in: Pipeline and Tools, Character and Animation, Rendering and Visuals, Environment and World. What you build is reviewed by people who do this for a living, and the review covers how you worked and how you talked to the people you built it for, not only what you delivered. Some of the work is yours alone and some is shared with the Engineering and Publishing graduates. Foundation Training runs on Unreal Engine, Maya, Python, and Perforce. The program assumes you arrive knowing one or two of them, not all four. **Three strategic rotations, six months each.** Rotations run across our studios, including Hangar 13, HB Studios, Visual Concepts, Firaxis, Small Axe, and Gearbox, and across the central technology teams that build the tools and pipelines every studio shares. Which team you rotate onto is decided around game timelines, and what the teams need at the time, and your own developing focus is part of that conversation. What we are looking for An outstanding portfolio is the first thing we look at, and it should show the work and how you got there. It does not have to be an art portfolio. Tools, scripts, rigs, shaders all count. If the work was made with other people, tell us which parts were yours. **There Are Two Things You Need** * Comfort in at least one content-creation package or game engine. Maya, Blender, Houdini, Substance, Unreal Engine, or whatever you happened to learn. * Some scripting. It does not need to be much, but you should be able to read code and have written something. **Beyond That, The Qualities That Matter Most** * Curiosity. You want to know how things are made, and you dig in to find out. * Persistence. A lot of this job is being stuck: something is broken, the reason is not obvious, and you keep going until you find it. * Communication. You will spend more time talking and asking questions than most people expect. **Education.** Game Art, Animation, VFX, Technical Art, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. We also take people with any unrelated degree who have a portfolio that shows the work. What you have made matters more to us than where you studied. The key is that you have a recent degree. **Experience.** No games industry experience is needed. This is a graduate program, and it is built for people who have never worked in games. Mod work, game jams, university projects, and freelance work are all relevant experiences as far as we are concerned. **Recent graduates.** Eligible Grads from January 2025 to June 2027 are eligible to apply. Exceptions may be made on a case-by-case basis if your grad date falls outside of these dates. Technical Art is a job people arrive at from many directions, so apply even if you do not match every line above. How to apply Send a CV/resume and a portfolio. The portfolio can be an ArtStation page, a personal site, a GitHub profile, an itch.io page, a reel, or a PDF. Which platform it lives on matters much less than whether we can open it and follow what we are looking at. If your work is spread across several places, link all of them and tell us which one to start with. If your resume doesn't explicitly have Tech Art, you're welcome to create a cover letter for us to review telling us why you're interested in this program. Cover letters are entirely optional. As an equal opportunity employer, we are committed to ensuring that qualified individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform their essential job functions, and receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us if you need a reasonable accommodation. title: Branch Assistant

Make a difference every day.** Are you someone who enjoys being on the move, takes pride in delivering excellent customer service and likes working as part of a close-knit team? We're looking for a **Branch Assistant** to join our busy branch, where no two days are the same. This is a varied, hands-on role combining customer deliveries, warehouse operations and branch support to help us provide an exceptional experience for our customers. Whether you're out making deliveries, supporting warehouse operations or helping customers at the trade counter, you'll play a vital role in keeping the branch running smoothly and ensuring we deliver on our customer promise. **What We Offer** * Competitive Salary – We regularly review our salaries to keep your earnings competitive. * Enhanced Annual Leave (Including Bank Holidays) – Enjoy a great work-life balance with plenty of time off to recharge. * Exciting Career Growth – Unlock personal development and career opportunities across the UK & Europe. * Life Assurance for Peace of Mind – Providing financial security for you and your loved ones. * 24/7 Employee Assistance Programme – Confidential support for you and your family, whenever you need it. * Company Funded Health Plan - access an online GP, a hospital plan, money back on medical expenses and other wellness benefits * Cycle to Work Scheme – Save money while staying active with tax-free bike purchases. * Retail & Staff Discounts – Enjoy exclusive savings on popular brands and products. **Key Responsibilities** As a Branch Assistant, you'll support every aspect of the branch operation, helping the team deliver excellent service, maintain high operational standards and achieve business goals. Delivering outstanding customer service * Deliver products safely, accurately and on time, ensuring every customer receives excellent service. * Build positive relationships with customers and represent the business professionally at every opportunity. * Support Click & Collect customers and assist at the trade counter when needed. * Help resolve customer queries and contribute to a positive customer experience. Supporting warehouse operations * Pick, pack and prepare customer orders accurately and efficiently. * Assist with goods receiving, stock movements and dispatch activities. * Maintain excellent stock accuracy through daily stock checks and inventory procedures. * Support stock takes and ensure products are stored safely and correctly. * Help maintain excellent shelf availability and warehouse organisation. Looking after our fleet * Carry out daily vehicle safety checks before every journey. * Ensure company vehicles remain clean, roadworthy and compliant with company standards. * Use delivery technology, including ePOD systems and handheld devices, accurately and effectively. * Drive safely at all times, promoting our safety-first culture and protecting our customers, colleagues and communities. Working safely and efficiently * Follow all Health & Safety procedures within the branch, warehouse and during deliveries. * Handle stock safely to minimise damage and maintain quality standards. * Complete mandatory training and compliance activities. * Support branch audits, operational controls and governance requirements. Being part of the team * Attend daily team briefings and contribute ideas to improve branch performance. * Work collaboratively with colleagues across the branch to achieve shared goals. * Support continuous improvement by helping deliver operational and customer service targets. * Develop your skills through ongoing learning and training, becoming a valued multi-skilled member of the team. **Skills And Experience** We're looking for someone with a positive attitude, great work ethic and a passion for delivering excellent customer service. **You'll Ideally Have** * Previous experience in a delivery driving, warehouse, logistics or branch support role. * A full driving licence. * Strong communication and customer service skills. * The ability to work efficiently in a busy, fast-paced environment. * Good organisational skills and attention to detail. * An understanding of safe working practices and Health & Safety. * Basic IT skills and confidence using handheld devices or warehouse systems. * A flexible, reliable and team-focused approach. Experience within the automotive, retail or logistics sector would be an advantage, as would knowledge of stock control, warehouse operations, vehicle compliance or ePOD technology—but these aren't essential, as full training will be provided. **Why Work for LKQ** We're proud of the service we provide to our customers, and we know that's only possible because of the great people who work in our branches. **When You Join Us, You'll Enjoy** * A varied, active role where no two days are the same. * Full training and ongoing development opportunities. * A supportive, friendly team environment. * Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career. * The chance to make a real difference to customers every day. Ready to join the team? If you're reliable, customer-focused and enjoy working in a fast-paced environment where every day brings something different, we'd love to hear from you. **Apply today and become an important part of a team that's committed to delivering exceptional service, every single day.** *We are committed to building an inclusive workplace where everyone feels welcome, valued and supported. We encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences and communities.*

title: Building Management Systems Engineer

An exciting opportunity has opened up for a Junior BMS Engineer to join a highly respected BMS integrator working on some of the most innovative commercial, pharmaceutical and mission-critical projects across Ireland. **Dublin, Ireland** * €40,000 - €45,000 * Yearly Bonus * Company Vehicle * Full Training and Development * Private Healthcare **Responsibilities:** * Assist in the design, commissioning and support of BMS systems across a variety of cutting-edge projects. * Work closely with senior engineers and project managers to gain hands-on experience with systems like Trend, Tridium or Cylon. * Get involved in both on-site and office-based work, no two days are the same. * Learn the full project lifecycle from specification and design, through to programming, installation and commissioning. **Experience Required:** * Degree or diploma in electrical engineering, building services, mechatronics or a related field. * Electrically Qualified. * A passion for automation, controls or energy-efficient building systems * Excellent problem-solving skills and eagerness to learn * Ideally some exposure to HVAC or BMS systems (through a placement, internship, or coursework). **What’s On Offer:** * Competitive salary and benefits package * Structured training and development plan * Opportunity to gain certifications and hands-on experience with industry-leading BMS technologies * Career progression with a clear pathway toward project engineering and senior roles * Collaborative team environment with supportive mentors For more information please contact: luke.alliband@clear-er.com

title: Butchery Operative - Dublin
description: **COMPANY OVERVIEW** Sysco connects the world to share food and care for one another. Sysco leads from the heart of food and service to deliver the freshest of foods and ideas to restaurants, healthcare and educational facilities, lodging establishments and other customers who prepare meals away from home. Our customers can count on us to deliver on-point products and solutions since only Sysco is the global leader, sitting at the heart of innovation supply, delivery, culinary and more. As the leading foodservice provider across the island of Ireland, Sysco's success is driven by a team of passionate and dedicated individuals who go above and beyond to deliver every day. We don't just deliver food and drink to our customers. We deliver new thinking, technology and talent to our industry. We deliver opportunities - to ourselves and to our colleagues ensuring that we can all thrive in work and beyond. We are now looking for new talent to join us as we continue to grow, innovate and deliver. **Butchery Operative- Dublin** We are excited to offer a fantastic opportunity for a **Butchery Operative- Dublin** a role which will play a key part in the overall growth of the organisation along with helping to maintain our core ethos here are Sysco - keeping the customer at the heart of everything we do. The role requires a candidate who will be: * Collaborative and a good team player * Self-motivated and results driven * Eager to expand Knowledge and Skills If you are ready for a challenge, we want to hear from you. Apply today and discover what your career could look like with Sysco Ireland. **Key Accountabilities:** * Develop a good working knowledge of product, placement, and inventory control techniques and procedures * Goods inwards and stock controller * Check weigh-in and product specification * Oversee storage of products, particularly stock rotation * Carry out end of week stock take for the financial controller * Health and Safety of yourself and others around you * Always follow Sysco preferred work methods, and immediately advise supervisor of any unsafe conditions * Reporting damages, accidents and issues relating to Food Safety * Basic IT skills only required * Hygiene in your department and good housekeeping * Must be willing to support the Butchery team when available * Induction training will be provided **Requirements:** * Be a highly motivated individual * Be a team player with ability to work on own initiave * Experience in a fast-paced meat production/ food preparation environment advantageous * Follow procedures to comply with HACCP policy. * Must be able to communicate effectively at all levels of the business, as it relates to the job and the safety regulations * Good communication skills * Fluent in English language essential (both written and verbal) * Experience of following food safety and quality procedures and policies. * Flexible and adaptable **Sysco Ireland Culture** * **Customer Focus:** We deeply understand our customers' needs, continuously looking at ways to deliver real value. * **Building Relationships:** We foster strong, effective relationships across teams, always working together. We embrace change and support each other through it. * **Clear Communication:** We communicate clearly and effectively, ensuring our message resonates. * **A Passion for Food:** We source and deliver food and drink that inspires excellence and creativity in kitchens for the most memorable dining experiences. The accountabilities and requirements outlined in this job description are neither definitive nor restrictive and may change in detail from time-to-time to meet the changing needs of the business. Sysco is an equal opportunity employer. #INDOPS

title: Clinical Specialist Radiographer – MRI (Fixed Term Contract)
description: **Job Description** **Job Title: Clinical Specialist Radiographer - MRI** **Department: Radiology** **Reports to: Head of Radiology Operations** **Date: 2027** **\*Initial 6 month contract with hopes to extend for another 6 months\*** **Overall Purpose of Job** We will provide exceptional patient care in an environment where quality, respect, caring and compassion are at the centre of all we do. The position of Clinical Specialist Radiographer requires an ability to lead, guide and supervise Radiographic staff and to successfully manage service delivery on a day to day basis. An ability to manage in a rapidly changing environment and a willingness to undertake such additional duties as may be assigned from time to time are essential. While carrying out the duties appropriate to a Radiographer in the MRI department, maintenance of professional competence in other areas of the department is necessary as some participation in the on-call service is required. This will necessitate the post holder in rotating through other areas in the department on a periodic basis. **Key Responsibilities and Deliverables** Clinical Operations: undertake as team leader, primary responsibility on a day-to-day basis for the MRI service and the effective utilisation of all resources allocated. Be accountable for the quality of the service provided, including customer service and technical aspects. Contribute to the development and implementation of operational policies, protocols and guidelines to ensure optimum utilisation of resources and systematic audit of such usage. Advise on equipment selection, purchase, replacement or upgrading. Contribute to the preparation of plans of service - monitor and report on their implementation. Implement and maintain accurate information systems for clinical data in accordance with hospital standards. Ensure the Head of Radiology is provided with accurate records of equipment service, maintenance, malfunction, downtime and performance as required and co-ordinate preventative maintenance schedules in accordance with clinical demand. Maintain up to date knowledge of clinical, technical and radiographic developments in relation to MRI and promote awareness of new developments. Ensure that best practices are implemented. Contribute to financial planning and ensure that appropriate budgetary control procedures are implemented. Support the Head of Radiology in the implementation of initiatives aimed at on-going service development, improvement and increase in volume. Provide professional support and advice to patients, radiographers, radiologists, medical staff, nurses and other allied health professionals. Promote and maintain a safe environment for staff and patients. Assist in the development and implementation of risk management and health and safety strategies in association with appropriate personnel. Develop and maintain a training function as may be required in relation to qualified staff and/or trainees and students. Supervise and assess all training as required. Liaise with the Head of Radiology on the rotation of staff through the Department to ensure an adequate number of trained staff are available. Liaise with the Head of Radiology on human resource issues as appropriate. Quality Assurance: Investigate and take appropriate action in accordance with hospital policy in relation to complaints, accidents and incidents. Ensure that all hospital policies and relevant up to date information on MRI safety is understood by staff and complied with. Ensure all hospital policies on infection control, IV policy and health and safety etc. are understood by staff and complied with. Implement and maintain a quality assurance programme in the MRI department as set out by Head of Radiology. Demonstrate flexibility in possible changes to work patterns e.g. extending working hours in MRI in order to accommodate our patients once volume increases significantly. Other duties assigned that are appropriate to the post. All posts in Radiology Services will be continually assessed in line with service requirements and changes with the development of the Hospital. Consequently, the duties of the post may change. **Quality:** Assist the Head of Radiology with Policies and Procedure development as appropriate Implement quality improvement as necessary to ensure safety of patients and staff Perform departmental audits that feed into the organisation quality programme Attend relevant meetings as requested by Head of Radiology Assist Head of Radiology in the preparation for accreditation surveys **Person Specification** **Qualifications** BSc (Hons) Diagnostic Radiography or equivalent. Post graduate MRI diploma/MSc Validation from the Irish Institute of Radiographers **Experience** A minimum of 6 years experience in the chosen modality or a post graduate qualification in the modality plus a minimum of 3 years experience. Demonstrate experience of working with a team of Radiographers. Competent in intravenous cannulation and contrast/buscopan administration. Evidence of post registration professional development. **Job Specific Competencies and Knowledge;** **Teamwork** * Demonstrate ability to work as part of a multi-disciplinary team. * Demonstrate motivation and an innovative approach to the role. **Knowledge/Professional Knowledge** * Demonstrate clinical competence and relevant experience in an MRI department. * Demonstrate an ability to contribute to overall service development. **Planning & Organisational Skills** * Have a high capacity for responsibility and individual initiative. * Demonstrate organisational skills including effective time management. * Demonstrate ability to manage clinical and non-clinical situations. * Have a proven ability to work under pressure. **Communication & Interpersonal Skills** * Demonstrate excellent communication skills, especially the ability to communicate clear and concise instructions to patients in an understandable manner. * Be able to deal with staff and management at all levels within the organisation. * Demonstrate strong interpersonal skills. **Customer/Client Focus** * Demonstrate an awareness and appreciation of the service user. * Demonstrate evidence of ability to empathise with and treat patients, relatives and colleagues with dignity and respect **Personal Competencies** All posts in Beacon Hospital require a high level of flexibility to ensure the delivery of an effective and efficient service. Therefore, the post holder will be required to demonstrate flexibility as and when required by their manager or hospital management.

title: Concierge
description: **Job Description** **Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You** The **Conrad Dublin** is a 5\* hotel and part of the Hilton Luxury Division. We aim to ‘offer smart luxury travelers inspiring connections & intuitive service in a world of style’. We are one of the best 5\* luxury hotels in the country. *“Conrad is Empowering and Bold”* **Benefits** Working for Hilton means you are joining an international company with more than 9000 hotels across the globe with countless benefits & career development opportunities such as: * Travel - Up to 40 nights per year at discounted rates and 50% off F&B in Hilton Hotels around the world. Plus up to 70 nights of discounts for your Family and Friends * Team Member Gym – a dedicated team member gym with free access 7 days a week * Benefit – Discounted rates for Conrad Team members across a wide range of retailers * Development – Hilton have numerous learning & development plans for all types of roles and career paths as well as free access to LinkedIn Learning and Harvard Manage Mentor * Holidays – 30 days holiday (incl BH) plus long service entitlement of an extra day per year up to a total of 5 additional days * Maternity & Paternity – Paid leave for those that qualify **Responsibilities** Here's what you'll do during a typical day: * Requirements: Applicants must hold a full, valid EU driving licence. * Valet Parking: This role includes valet parking responsibilities, ensuring guests receive a smooth, efficient, and professional service from arrival to departure. * Delight our guests: Respond promptly and professionally to guest inquiries, requests, and concerns * Offer recommendations: Provide information and handle arrangements for dining, transportation, events, tours, and local attractions * Coordinate special services: Arrange for medical care, childcare, floral delivery, and other personalised guest needs * Manage guest communications: Receive and deliver messages, mail, packages, and faxes * Support VIP guests: Facilitate seamless registration and elevated service for high-priority guests * Promote hotel offerings: Share marketing materials and encourage use of hotel services and programs **Qualifications** **What It Takes to Make the Stay** At Hilton, Our Core Values Define What It Takes To Succeed Here And Guide The Qualities We Look For In Every Team Member A passion for spreading the light and warmth of **Hospitality** . Acting with **Integrity** and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through **Leadership** . A belief that **Teamwork** drives the best outcomes. A sense of **Ownership** and accountability. And a focus on the **Now** , bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact. **About Us** **Join an Award-Winning Workplace Culture** At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. As a global leader in hospitality, we’ve welcomed more than 3 billion guests worldwide, all while staying true to our founding vision: to fill the earth with the light and warmth of hospitality. Our award-winning culture has earned us repeated recognition on the World’s Best Workplaces list by Great Place to Work and Fortune. With our suite of world-class brands , and a company-wide commitment to providing the best stay for every guest, we’re setting new standards for the future of travel. Whether you’re starting your career or exploring something new, Hilton supports your journey every step of the way. Come for the job, stay for the career—and help us make every stay a little more magical. Curious about life at Hilton? Explore our Careers Blog to see why we’re more than a great place to stay—we’re a great place to work.

title: Customer Assistant
description: Joining us as a Customer Assistant is a great opportunity, whether it’s your first job and you’re looking to gain some valuable experience, or you have experience with retail and you’re looking for a new challenge, this is the start of a new career with us **About The Role** You will work onsite and report into the Assistant or Store Manager and your role could be to help on the tills, advise our customers, or work in our back shop. You will also: * Help our customers and put them at ease; whether that’s listening to find out more about them, answering questions and giving great advice on our fantastic products, recommending items they hadn’t considered or simply offering a basket - it's the little things that make a difference * Get to know our in-store offers and schemes and promote them - the more info we can give our customers, the better. * Help our stores run smoothly - this could look like ensuring we have the right products displayed on the shop floor, providing a great service on our tills, or helping with our stock in in the stock rooms * Work with other members in the team to provide a great shopping experience, ensuring the store is always clean and presentable to provide a store everyone can be proud of **What You’ll Need To Have** Full training is provided for this role, and we are looking for people who * Excel in a varied environment, working at pace * Communicate and listen effectively * Enjoy working as part of a team, promoting a collaborative team dynamic * Know that the little things make the biggest difference for customer interactions * Desire to be a proud brand ambassador for Boots and help our customers find the best products for them **It would be great if you also have** * Experience providing customer care and delivering great customer service but this is not essential. **Our Benefits** * Pension membership (PRSA) * Partial paid maternity leave * Discretionary annual bonus * Generous employee discounts * Flexible benefits scheme We have a great range of benefits in addition to the above that offer flexibility to suit you - find out more at **boots.jobs/ireland** . As the heart of everything we do at Boots, with you, we change for the better. **What's Next** If your application is successful, you'll be invited to an in-store interview in the next 14 days. title: Data Protection/Freedom of Information Officer/Oifigeach Cosanta Sonraí / um Shaoráil Faisnéise
description: **Position: Data Protection/Freedom of Information Officer** **Contract: Permanent Part-time - Onsite** **Hours: 21 hours per week** **Salary range: HSE Consolidated pay-scale (Current Applicable Scale)** **Reporting to: Chief Executive Officer** **Closing date: 19 October 2026** **Organisational Context** Clontarf Hospital is a 160-bed Voluntary Hospital providing rehabilitation Services under Section 38 of the Health Act 2004 for Adults and Older Persons. At Clontarf Hospital, our committed, expert and compassionate staff provide excellent care to patients on their rehabilitation journey. Our goal is to work in partnership with patients, providing care that is tailored to their unique needs, empowering them to achieve their optimum level of independence at home and in their communities. The patient pathways include: * Older Persons Rehabilitation * Step-up beds and hospital avoidance pathways with the Integrated Care Team for Older Persons (ICPOP Team) * Specialist Rehabilitation Services including neuro-rehabilitation and rehabilitation after trauma for adults and older persons * Orthopaedic Rehabilitation The Hospital has close links with the Mater Hospital, Beaumont Hospital, The National Orthopaedic Hospital, HSE Services and our Community Partners. **Role Summary** The Data Protection / Freedom of Information Officer holds primary operational and statutory responsibility for overseeing Clontarf Hospitals adherence to data protection laws and the Freedom of Information (FOI) Act 2014. The post holder reports directly to the Chief Executive Officer, maintaining the professional independence required to act as the formal statutory Data Protection Officer (DPO) and formal Information Decision Maker. **Essential Criteria** * Hold a 3rd Level qualification in a relevant field e.g., Data Protection, Information Compliance, Law, Records Management or a related discipline. * Have a minimum of 2 years experience in the area of Data Protection, Information Management and/or Records Management or similar role. * Experience managing GDPR and FOI processes. * Strong knowledge of Irish and EU Data Protection legislation. * Excellent organisational, analytical and decision-making skills. * High standard of integrity, professional judgement and communication skills. * Ability to work with multiple internal and external stakeholders. * Fluent command and understanding of the English language to include spoken and written word. **Duties and Responsibilities** **Data Protection Advisory & Compliance** * Act as the principal point of contact for the Data Protection Commission (DPC) on all data protection issues and monitor all ongoing responses to regulatory requests. * Serve as the formal point of contact for internal and external regulatory organisations, patients, and staff regarding the processing of personal data. * Act as the first point of contact for data subjects wishing to make a formal complaint in relation to their rights and freedoms. * Work with the hospitals ICT manager to develop ICT policies and procedures as they relate to GDPR, privacy laws, and data protection. * Assist and advise on corporate business decisions that carry data protection implications, ensuring that decisions are designed with data protection and privacy in mind. * Provide structured GDPR and Data Protection Act compliance planning and advisory support to Heads of Services/Departments in the hospital as necessary. * Assist and advise on the development, enhancement, and revision of Hospital policies, procedures, standards, guidelines, best practices, templates, and checklists. Ensure materials reflect changes in laws, regulatory mandates, or Hospital standards to drive operational consistency. * Prepare and communicate comprehensive reports regarding data protection compliance breaches and other relevant compliance updates to the CEO, the Executive Management Team, the Hospital Board and the Data Protection Commissioner. * Provide structured monthly updates directly to the CEO on all matters relating to data protection and GDPR compliance. * Ensure the timely adoption and execution of all GDPR and data privacy compliance requirements across all hospital departments. **Data Governance Operations & Registers** * Centralise, maintain, and formally audit the organisational Record of Processing Activities (RoPA)under Article 30 of the GDPR. * Maintain a centralised register of signed Clontarf Hospital Data Sharing Agreements (DSAs) * Provide ongoing advice to Heads of Departments regarding GDPR compliance to ensure that formal agreements are actively in place for all existing and new contracts with third parties who process (view, access, store, or process) identifiable patient or employee data. * Actively review and assess any reported data protection incidents recorded on the Hospitals Data Breach Log. Direct notifications to the Data Protection Commission as appropriate, and provide technical advice alongside letter templates to departments for formal breach notifications to affected data subjects. * Act as an advocate for data protection and privacy within Clontarf Hospital. Promote compliance by designing, updating, and delivering GDPR awareness and education training courses to hospital staff regarding the foundational importance of data protection in a rehabilitation hospital environment. **Data Protection Impact Assessments (DPIAs)** * Undertake and systematically review completed Data Protection Impact Assessments (DPIAs) submitted by internal departments and external stakeholders. * Audit all newly proposed data processing activities, including new ICT systems, new mobile applications, research ethics applications, and new Electronic Referral Systems etc. * Recommend clear mitigating steps to reduce data risks if they are not initially identified by stakeholders. Risks must be deemed entirely acceptable under statutory frameworks for the post holder to formally sign off on the activity from a GDPR perspective. **Freedom of Information (FOI) Decision Maker** * Responsibility for the end-to-end management of the hospital's FOI process. * Recording of requests, open communication with requesters, and adherence to statutory timeframes. * Co-ordinate and cross-reference records with relevant colleagues, hospital departments, and external agencies as appropriate. * Review and assess records, applying relevant legal exemptions appropriately to ensure strict adherence to the provisions of the FOI Act 2014. * Formulate and issue legally sound, timely decisions in line with the provisions of the FOI Act. * Maintain FOI files documenting the underlying decision and all relevant procedural matters to demonstrate institutional compliance with the Act and to aid internal or external reviews. * Liaise directly with the Appeals Officer when required. Prepare submissions to the Office of the Information Commissioner (OIC) when required. **GDPR Decision Maker (Information Requests / DSARs** * Lead the management of the GDPR process for all information requests, acting as the primary point of contact for Subject Access Requests under Article 15 of the GDPR. * Ensure the logging of requests, transparent communication with the requester, and adherence to strict statutory timelines. * Apply relevant restrictions or exemptions in line with GDPR and the Data Protection Acts 19882018. * Maintain files documenting the decision and all relevant procedural matters to demonstrate full compliance with GDPR and to aid independent reviews. * Compile and provide formal statistical information on SAR data for reporting to the EMT, Hospital Board and HSE Consumer Affairs. * Prepare formal submissions to the Office of the Data Protection Commission where required. **Competencies** **Leadership, Teamwork and Working with Multiple Internal and External Stakeholders** * Inspires commitment from a range of teams, brings complex matters to conclusion, regularly demonstrates unique insight and is an effective decision maker. * Have the ability to work on own initiative, be approachable and available for advice and support. * Motivates others individually and in teams to deliver high-quality work and develops effective and productive workplace relationships. * Maintains absolute focus, provides clarity and advice on all matters related to GDPR and data protection. * Demonstrates commitment to professional development. * Excellent evaluation, decision making, organisational and time management skills with the ability to work to deadlines. * Leads by example in terms of commitment, flexibility and a strong patient service ethos to achieve desired outcomes. * Harnesses resources to deliver on longer-term goals, manages resistance and setbacks as they arise. * Gathers information from enough sources and other people to make well-informed decisions. * Recognises when it is appropriate to refer issues to senior management. * Effectively introduces change, fosters a culture of creativity in employees and overcomes resistance to change. * Demonstrates flexibility and an openness to change and keeps abreast of new regulations and laws. * Good communication and team working capability, and an ability to take necessary actions and responsibility for the same. * Assist the Executive Management Team in achieving the hospitals strategic objectives as it relates to GDPR and data protection. **Communication** * Demonstrate excellent interpersonal and communicative skills across all clinical, administrative, and executive groups in the hospital * Provide reports for the CEO and Board as required. * Establish and maintain effective communication networks within service groups, wards and departments within the Hospital. * The post holder will work collaboratively with medical, nursing, pharmacy, health and social care professionals, administrative, ICT and support departments across Clontarf Hospital to establish and maintain effective corporate and departmental systems to ensure that all personal and sensitive health information is handled, processed, stored, and retained in line with Hospital policies, procedures, national healthcare standards, and applicable legislation. * Maintain effective liaison with the Data Protection Commissioner, relevant HSE personnel and other external stakeholders as required. **Learning and Education** * Promote and support a learning and continuous improvement culture across the Hospital * Lead, attend and participate in relevant staff development programmes on an ongoing basis and share knowledge with other staff members * Lead in the training of colleagues as required. * Identify training and professional development requirements across the Hospital **Risk Management and Compliance** * Ensure compliance with all relevant guidelines, policies, procedures and relevant legislation and regulatory requirements. * Participate in the continuous review and evaluation of policies, guidelines and existing practices through regular audit programmes and review engaging with the multi-disciplinary team where required. * Assist in promoting a culture of continuous quality improvement across the Hospital. * Participate in the requirements of the Hospitals risk management programme. * Support the delivery of a high standard of care to all patients. * Ensure compliance with the obligations required by the Data Protection Acts, GDPR and Freedom of Information (FOI) Acts. **CONFIDENTIALITY** In the course of your employment you may have access to, or hear information concerning, the medical or personal affairs of patients and/or staff, or other health service business. Such records and information are strictly confidential and, unless acting on the instructions of an authorised officer, on no account must information concerning staff, patients or other health service business be divulged or discussed except in the performance of normal duty. In addition, records must never be left in such a manner that unauthorised persons can obtain access to them and must be left in safe custody when no longer required. **The above role profile is not intended to be a comprehensive list of all duties involved and consequently the post holder may be required to perform other duties as appropriate to the post which may be assigned to him/her from time to time and to contribute to the development of the post while in office. This role profile will be subject to review in light of changing circumstances.** **Garda Clearance** Arrangements have been introduced, on a national level, for the provision of Garda Clearance in respect of candidates for employment in areas of the Health Services, where it is envisaged that potential employees would have substantial access to children or vulnerable individuals. Each candidate will be required to complete a Garda Clearance form. **Infection Control** Have a working knowledge of Health Information and Quality Authority (HIQA) Standards as they apply to the role, for example, Standards for Healthcare, National Standards for the Prevention and Control of Healthcare Associated Infections, Hygiene Standards etc. and comply with associated HSE and Hospital protocols for implementing and maintaining these standards as appropriate to the role. **Benefits and Opportunities** * Supportive, inclusive and collegial working environment that values staff wellbeing and mutual respect * Opportunity to gain broad and meaningful clinical experience across a diverse range of rehabilitation cases, supporting both professional confidence and career development * Strong collaborative working within a multidisciplinary team, promoting shared learning and best practice * Active support for Post-Graduate Education and Continuous Professional Development, with a strong emphasis on ongoing learning and professional growth * Flexible working arrangements, where possible, to support worklife balance * Access to free on-site car parking * Subsidised staff canteen * Membership of a public sector pension scheme * Access to Occupational Health Services * Staff support and counselling services, reflecting our commitment to employee wellbeing and psychological safety **OTHER REQUIREMENTS SPECIFIC TO THE POST** **The post holder may be required to perform other duties as appropriate to the post, which may be assigned to him/her from time to time, and to contribute to the development of the post while in office.** **This job description will be subject to review in the light of changing circumstances.** **It is not intended to be exhaustive but should be regarded as providing guidelines within which individuals work.** **The duties and responsibilities detailed above reflect the present service requirements and may be subject to review and amendment to meet the changing needs of the service.** Short listing may be carried out on the basis of information supplied in your Application Form. The criteria for short listing are based on the requirements of the post as outlined in the eligibility criteria and skills, competencies and/or knowledge section of this job specification. title: Junior Product Engineer
description: *European Air-Cooled Chiller Engineering | Dublin, Ireland* **What You Will Do** Johnson Controls has an exciting Product Engineer I opportunity based at our Dublin, Ireland location, supporting our new European air-cooled chiller engineering organization. If you are beginning your engineering career and enjoy mechanical design, hands-on testing, and data analysis, this could be the right position for you. In this entry-level role you will support the mechanical design and performance of air-cooled chiller components engineered for the European market, working under close supervision to complete design work as part of a project team. You will build your knowledge of our products, support laboratory testing and factory activity, and contribute to new and exciting product development programs while developing your technical expertise. **How You Will Do It** * Builds an understanding of the theories, concepts, technical principles, and processes related to the fluid, thermal, refrigeration, and other mechanical aspects of air-cooled chillers * Works under close supervision, following work instructions and defined processes, and takes direction from more experienced engineers * Follows the project plan and participates in design activities with other team members * Supports delivery of engineering deliverables, including design specifications, design reviews, data analysis, etc. * Learns and applies European mechanical and safety codes and directives, including CE marking, the Pressure Equipment Directive (PED), and the Machinery Directive, and harmonized standards such as EN 378 (refrigerating systems safety) and EN 14511 (chiller performance rating) * Supports the build, instrumentation, and running of laboratory test programs; participates in process improvement * Adheres to the Company’s Code of Conduct and Business Ethics standards **Required** **What we look for** * BS in Mechanical Engineering or a related engineering discipline / science * Entry level; previous internship, co-op, or work experience in a related field preferred * Understanding of fundamental fluid and thermal principles * Working knowledge of 3D CAD and engineering drawing practice * Willingness to learn and apply European mechanical and refrigeration codes and standards (CE marking, PED, Machinery Directive, EN 378) * Able to organize and process large amounts of data * Good written and verbal communication skills * Ability to work in a fast-paced, schedule-driven, team-oriented environment * Ability to travel up to 10%, primarily within Europe **Preferred** * Internship, co-op, or placement experience in HVAC, refrigeration, or another industrial product environment * Exposure to laboratory testing, instrumentation, and data acquisition * Familiarity with refrigeration systems and the EU F-Gas Regulation * Familiarity with HVAC systems and motor-driven mechanical engineering design and test * Exposure to structural, thermal, or computational fluid dynamics (CFD) analysis * Experience with ERP / material resource planning (MRP) software * Familiarity with European regulatory standards such as EN 378, EN 14511, and the Ecodesign / ErP framework #AVRIL

description: **Join Crowe Ireland’s 2027 Tax Graduate Programme!** Are you ready to kickstart your career and write your story with one of Ireland's top accounting and advisory firms? At **Crowe Ireland** , we’re not just about numbers we’re about people, innovation, and making a real impact. We’re advisors, partners, and innovators who help businesses grow, navigate their challenges, and build a brighter future. We work with a diverse mix of clients – from owner-managed business and not-for - profit to multinationals, government agencies and hospitality as a small example – Every day brings something new! As part of our team, you'll learn from the best, gain hands - on experience across a range of industries, and be part of a community that values **collaboration** , **curiosity** , and **creativity** . **Why choose Crowe Ireland?** At Crowe Ireland, we are a close knit team with a global reach. Our firm is all about fostering talent, encouraging fresh ideas, and driving positive change for our clients and community. We are big enough to offer great opportunities, international assignments and write a successful story and small enough for you to make great impacts on some of our projects from the word go. Join us, and you will be part of a dynamic and diverse team that values growth, learning and having a bit of fun along the way! If you want to know more about our Graduate Programme, visit our website. **What’s in it for You?** Our 2027 Tax Graduate Programme is designed to give you real world experience, professional development, and a fast track to becoming a qualified accountant and/or tax advisor. You’ll get to work with amazing clients, use trending technology, get a flavour of all specialties in Tax and learn from a team that genuinely cares about your success. Here’s what you’ll do: **Your Role:** 1. **Explore a Range of Tax Disciplines** : Get hands on experience with different areas of tax, including International Tax, Corporate Tax, Global Mobility, Personal Taxation and VAT. You’ll help businesses navigate the complexities of tax laws both locally and globally. 2. **Build leadership skills** : You will be assigned a portfolio of clients to manage. Managers and Partners will coach and support you, also review the quality of the service provided, but you will have the opportunity to build autonomy and leadership skills from day 1. 3. **Become a Data Detective** : Use the latest tools and techniques to analyse client data, research tax technical issues, and find smart solutions that add real value to our clients 4. **Build Meaningful Relationships** : You will work closely with clients and collaborate with other departments to deliver comprehensive solutions that meet their needs. 5. **Communication Pro** : Ensure managers, directors, and partners are always informed of progress, potential issues, and key insights on your assignments. You will work closely with partners, directors and other managers to deliver top-notch services to our clients. 6. **Deliver Excellence** : Contribute to high quality tax assignments, ensuring compliance, mitigating risks, and driving positive outcomes for our clients. **How we are going to support your development:** * Crowe will fully sponsor your accounting qualification: You will have the freedom to choose which accounting qualification you will pursue. ACA? ACCA? title: Technical Support Engineer - Dell Compute | PowerEdge & Modular (B2B) - Norwegian, Finnish, Italian, or Dutch speaking
description: **Technical Support Engineer - Dell Compute | PowerEdge & Modular (B2B)- Norwegian, Finnish, Italian or Dutch speaking** At Dell Technologies, world-class service doesn't end when our customer purchases our innovative products. Our Technical Support team is there for them whenever they need help - no matter how complex the challenge, we rise to it. We answer questions about the installation, operation, configuration, customization and use of Dell Technologies products. For critical matters, we use our systems to provide remote diagnostic technical support. If there's an issue with a customer's product, we will analyze it, identify the cause, recommend a solution and document the problem. Join us as a **Technical Support Engineer - Dell Compute | PowerEdge & Modular (B2B)** on our **Dell's Compute Technical Support team** in Ireland to do the best work of your career and make a profound social impact. **What you'll achieve** Our team is part of Dell's Compute Technical Support organization, providing enterprise-level (B2B) support for PowerEdge Rack&Tower, and Modular (MX series) server platforms. The Technical Support Engineer will serve as the first point of contact for business customers, diagnosing and resolving hardware and software issues across the PowerEdge portfolio. Day-to-day, the engineer will manage inbound cases, perform remote troubleshooting using Dell diagnostic tools, coordinate parts dispatches, and ensure timely resolution within SLA commitments. This role is ideal for someone passionate about enterprise infrastructure and delivering exceptional support to business-critical environments. **You will:** * **Diagnose and resolve** hardware and software issues on Dell PowerEdge Rack, Tower, and Modular (MX) server platforms for enterprise B2B customers via phone, chat, and remote sessions * **Utilize Dell diagnostic tools** including iDRAC, Lifecycle Controller, SupportAssist Enterprise, and Dell online diagnostics to identify root cause and drive resolution * **Manage case workload** effectively, ensuring all customer interactions are documented accurately and resolved within defined SLA/service contract commitments (ProSupport, ProSupport Plus, Basic) * **Coordinate parts dispatch and field engineers** when on-site hardware replacement is required, ensuring correct part identification and timely resolution * **Collaborate with escalation teams** (L2/L3 engineering) and cross-functional groups to resolve complex issues and contribute to knowledge base documentation for continuous improvement **Take the first step towards your dream career** Every Dell Technologies team member brings something unique to the table. Here's what we are looking for with this role: **Essential Requirements** * Foundational understanding of **server hardware architecture** - processors, memory (DIMMs), hard drives (SAS/SATA/NVMe), RAID controllers (PERC), power supplies, and cooling systems * Basic knowledge of **server operating systems** including Windows Server and Linux distributions (RHEL, SLES, or Ubuntu Server) * Understanding of **networking fundamentals** (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, NIC configuration) as they relate to server connectivity and management interfaces * Strong **analytical and troubleshooting skills** with a structured, methodical approach to problem-solving * Excellent **communication and customer service skills** with the ability to manage expectations in a professional B2B enterprise environment * **Norwegian, Finnish, Italian or Dutch speaking** **Desirable Requirements** * Hands-on experience or familiarity with **Dell PowerEdge platforms, iDRAC, OpenManage Enterprise, or Dell Modular (MX) infrastructure** including chassis management (OME-Modular) * Relevant industry certifications such as **CompTIA Server+, CompTIA A+, Dell Certified (DCA/DCE), or Microsoft/Linux certifications** - or prior experience in a data center, server, or enterprise technical support role **Who we are** We believe that each of us has the power to make an impact. That's why we put our team members at the center of everything we do. If you're looking for an opportunity to grow your career with some of the best minds and most advanced tech in the industry, we're looking for you. Dell Technologies is a unique family of businesses that helps individuals and organizations transform how they work, live and play. Join us to build a future that works for everyone because Progress Takes All of Us. Dell Technologies is committed to the principle of equal employment opportunity for all employees and to providing employees with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. Read the full Equal Employment Opportunity Policy here.

title: Telco NOC Specialist (L1, Europe)
description: **Company Overview** Holafly is a high-growth scale-up revolutionising how businesses and travellers connect to the internet abroad. Since 2018, we’ve empowered travellers in over 200 destinations worldwide with secure and reliable eSIM solutions. With a team of 600+ professionals across multiple countries, we are scaling globally to support travellers with seamless, unlimited data connectivity. We’re not just connecting people—we’re enabling freedom and peace of mind, ensuring our users stay connected from the second they land, wherever their journey takes them. The Role As our NOC / L1 Support Specilist, you will be the first line of defense in ensuring global connectivity by monitoring our MVNE platform and resolving roaming technicalities. Your work directly impacts our brand promise of uninterrupted data, ensuring every traveler stays online regardless of their destination. Key Responsibilities * Monitor and maintain service availability across our global networks using platforms like Zabbix to identify and resolve technical anomalies. * Diagnose and troubleshoot complex eSIM and roaming registration flows to ensure rapid restoration of traveler connectivity. * Manage the SIM lifecycle, from APN configurations to IMSI/ICCID validation, ensuring seamless activation for all users. * Collaborate across teams, acting as the technical bridge between Customer Service and L2 engineering to escalate critical incidents effectively. * Document operational processes and technical workflows to build a robust knowledge base that scales with our rapid growth. * Drive service quality by tracking performance indicators and proactively identifying potential connectivity bottlenecks before they affect users. **Qualifications** * Professional experience in a NOC, Technical Support, or Telecommunications operational environment. * Foundational knowledge of mobile network elements (4G/5G) and roaming concepts like HSS, PGW, and APN settings. * Technical curiosity for eSIM technologies, including activation flows and SM-DP+ basics. * Strong communication skills, with the ability to translate technical issues into clear updates for non-technical stakeholders. * Adaptability to thrive in a fast-paced, "brave" scale-up environment where quick learning is essential. **Nice-to-haves** * Basic understanding of Diameter (ULR/ULA) or MAP/SS7 protocols. * Experience with Jira or similar enterprise ticketing systems. Benefits & Perks * Remote-first culture with a focus on outcome over hours. * Flexible working schedule to support your work-life balance. * The opportunity to grow within a blameless, collaborative environment that values ownership and continuous improvement. During a trip to Thailand, Pedro and Lidia, the founders of Holafly, experienced the frustration of not having an internet connection. Inspired by their own experiences, they came up with a simple but brilliant idea: why not allow travellers to buy data plans for any destination from their home country? Our passion for providing easy and convenient connectivity to travellers around the world drives everything we do. We love our work and we do it with pride. Stay connected wherever you go.

title: Trainee Development Coordinator
description: **Job Title:** **Trainee Development Coordinator** **Location:** Dublin **Hours:** **37 hours per week** **About Us:** Tuath Housing has provided safe, secure and affordable housing since 2006. A lot has changed over the years, but our values remain the same. In partnership with Key Stakeholders, our main focus is on delivering more quality homes to more people and providing an outstanding Customer experience to our 27,000 residents. title: Vehicle Handler
description: **About NVD** A family-owned business, established in 1980, NVD was set up to assist vehicle manufacturers in the timely and incident free distribution of their products. We’ve established ourselves as a one stop shop providing the three main pillars of outbound logistics, including transporting, storing and enhancing our customers’ vehicles, prior to delivery to their end location. Since 1980 NVD has been at the forefront of pioneering the digitisation of the FVL industry. As early adopters of emerging technology we have been able to introduce huge efficiencies saving time and money for our customers. Our unwavering commitment to progress and continual service improvement remains at the heart of our business today. **Role Summary** The role is responsible for the safe and efficient movement, inspection, and handling of vehicles within storage compounds and loading areas. This includes carrying out vehicle checks on arrival and dispatch, completing stock audits, and ensuring compounds are maintained to a high standard. The successful candidate will handle the movement of a high volume of vehicles—typically 60 or more per day—between designated areas, ensuring accuracy, care, and adherence to safety procedures. They will support the wider operations team in maintaining an organised, efficient, and compliant vehicle flow process. The role requires a **full driving licence** , flexibility to work shifts (including evenings and up to six days per week), and the ability to work outdoors in varying weather conditions. A positive attitude, reliability, and comfort driving both cars and light commercial vehicles are essential. We have excellent career opportunities in Baldonnell, Co Dublin for Vehicle Handlers. **Compensation & Benefits** * 17.00 per hour including shift premium paid (3.9 hours equivalent) at standard hourly rate * Pension Scheme * Death In Service Benefit * Digital GP Service * Employee Assistance Programme * Annual Leave Purchase Programme * Long Service Awards * Staff Purchase Schemes: **Responsibilities** * Tyres * Tools * Bike to Work * Discounted Gym Membership * Checking vehicles upon arrival and dispatch * Moving multiple vehicles between compounds * Vehicle specific inspections * Stock Checks * General maintenance and upkeep of compounds **Requirements** * Ability to work outside and with shift work schedule * Availability to work between multiple compounds * Available for work up to 6 days a week and availability to work evening shifts * Full driving license * Positive working attitude * Comfortable with driving cars and light commercial vehicles **Equal Opportunities Statement** National Vehicle Distribution is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. We value openness, innovation, customer focus, and operational excellence. Our organisation actively promotes equality and prohibits discrimination based on gender, marital/civil status, family status, age, disability, sexual orientation, race, religion, or membership of the Traveller community, in accordance with Irish and UK equality legislation. We encourage applications from all qualified individuals and are dedicated to creating an environment where everyone can thrive and contribute to our shared success. #IND2

title: Veterinary Nurse
description: **Veterinary Nurse** -------------------- ### **All Care Veterinary Centre | Walkinstown, Dublin** ### **Full-Time | Permanent** ### **40 Hours Per Week** ### **Salary €32,000 - €35,000+ DOE** **Launch or Grow Your Nursing Career in a Busy, Supportive Practice** --------------------------------------------------------------------- All Care Veterinary Centre is looking for a Veterinary Nurse to join our friendly and experienced team in Walkinstown. We welcome applications from VCI Registered Veterinary Nurses, Student Veterinary Nurses due to qualify and register in 2026, and nurses at all stages of their career. Whether you're newly qualified and eager to build confidence, or an experienced nurse looking for a practice where your skills will be fully utilised, this is an excellent opportunity to develop your career within a busy first-opinion environment. We are passionate about creating a workplace where nurses are encouraged to be hands-on, actively involved in patient care and supported to pursue their professional interests. Rather than being limited to routine tasks, you'll gain valuable exposure across a wide range of clinical areas and be given the opportunity to develop practical skills that make a real difference to patient outcomes. **A Role That Offers True Clinical Exposure** --------------------------------------------- This is a varied, engaging nursing role where you'll be involved in all aspects of patient care and practice life. Working alongside our experienced veterinary team, you'll play a key role in surgical nursing, anaesthesia monitoring, inpatient care, nurse consultations, laboratory work, client communication and patient recovery. We believe veterinary nurses should be empowered to use their skills to their fullest potential and actively encourage nurse involvement throughout the patient journey. From supporting surgical procedures and medical workups to running consultations and providing client education, you'll have the opportunity to build confidence and develop a comprehensive range of nursing skills. For less experienced nurses, this role offers exceptional mentorship and support. For experienced nurses, it provides the autonomy and clinical exposure needed to continue progressing and expanding your capabilities. **Develop Your Career Your Way** -------------------------------- At All Care Veterinary Centre, we understand that every nurse has different career ambitions. Whether you're interested in medicine, surgery, dentistry, behaviour, nutrition, emergency and critical care, anaesthesia or another area entirely, we'll support you in developing those interests. We are committed to investing in our nurses and are proud to offer full funding for Nursing Certificates (NCerts) and further professional development opportunities. If there is a particular area of practice you are passionate about, we'll work with you to help build the skills, knowledge and qualifications needed to achieve your goals. This is a practice where career progression isn't just encouraged, it's actively supported. **Join a Team That Enjoys Working Together** -------------------------------------------- All Care Veterinary Centre is a modern, well-established small animal practice with a strong reputation for delivering high-quality patient care and exceptional customer service to the local community. You'll be joining a supportive team consisting of Veterinary Surgeons, Veterinary Nurses, a Student Veterinary Nurse, Reception and Practice Management colleagues who genuinely enjoy working together. Collaboration, kindness and teamwork are central to our culture, and we're proud of the positive environment we've created for both our team and our clients. Our nurses are highly valued members of the practice and play an important role in shaping the patient experience, supporting colleagues and contributing to the continued success of the clinic. **Work-Life Balance That Works** -------------------------------- This is a permanent full-time position based on 40 hours per week and worked on a rotational rota between Monday and Saturday. Weekday shifts fall between 8.00am and 7.00pm, with participation in a shared Saturday rota. There are no Sunday shifts, no Bank Holiday commitments and no out-of-hours responsibilities, helping you maintain a healthy balance between work and personal life. **Who We're Looking For** ------------------------- We're looking for a Veterinary Nurse who is enthusiastic, compassionate and committed to delivering exceptional patient care. You may be a nurse looking for your next challenge, a recently qualified RVN keen to build your confidence and skills, or a student nurse preparing to qualify in 2026. What matters most is a willingness to learn, a positive attitude and a desire to make a meaningful contribution as part of a supportive clinical team. You'll enjoy working in a busy environment, have excellent communication skills and take pride in building strong relationships with clients, patients and colleagues alike. **Benefits (Subject to Pro-Rata)** ---------------------------------- ### **Work-Life Balance & Wellbeing** * 4.4 weeks annual leave package plus birthday leave * Paid maternity, paternity and adoptive leave * Paid bereavement leave * Company sick pay * Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) * Cycle to Work scheme * Free flu vaccinations ### **Professional Development** * €600 CPD allowance plus 3 paid CPD days (pro rata) * Funded certificates, diplomas and PhDs * Access to bespoke career development programmes, including Graduate Nurse Academy and Nurse Evolve * Structured career progression pathways * Leadership Academy for aspiring Head Nurses and Practice Managers ### **Additional Benefits** * "Pawsome" perks, including retail discounts and virtual gym memberships * Discounted veterinary care for your own pets * Employer pension contributions * Access to internal networks and communities, including LGBTQIA+, Wellbeing Champions, Nurse Committee and Clinical Board groups **Why Join All Care Veterinary Centre?** ---------------------------------------- This is an outstanding opportunity to join a practice where veterinary nurses are encouraged to fully utilise their skills, develop their interests and build rewarding long-term careers. If you're looking for a supportive team, excellent clinical exposure, hands-on nursing responsibilities and genuine opportunities for growth, we'd love to hear from you. Join All Care Veterinary Centre and develop the skills, confidence and career you've been looking for. Up to €35,000+ DOE We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information.
